description: This file defines the OverridesSectionStorage class for Drupal's layout builder module, implementing a custom section storage type with methods for managing layout overrides, route building, access control, and context derivation.

classes.name: OverridesSectionStorage
classes.description: Defines a custom section storage plugin for Drupal's layout builder, handling layout overrides, route building, access control, and context management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies like entity managers, repositories, and current user.

methods.name: getSectionList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of sections from the entity.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity that stores the layout overrides.

methods.name: getStorageId
methods.description: Generates a unique storage ID based on the entity type and ID.

methods.name: getTempstoreKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key for temporary storage, including view mode and language.

methods.name: deriveContextsFromRoute
methods.description: Derives contexts from route parameters, extracting the entity if present.

methods.name: extractEntityFromRoute
methods.description: Parses route values to retrieve the associated entity.

methods.name: buildRoutes
methods.description: Builds routes for entity types supporting layout overrides.

methods.name: buildLocalTasks
methods.description: Builds local task links for layout editing per entity type.

methods.name: hasIntegerId
methods.description: Checks if the entity's ID is an integer type.

methods.name: getEntityTypes
methods.description: Returns entity types that support layout builder features.

methods.name: getDefaultSectionStorage
methods.description: Loads the default section storage display for the entity.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns URL to redirect to the entity's canonical page.

methods.name: getLayoutBuilderUrl
methods.description: Generates URL for the layout builder interface.

methods.name: getContextsDuringPreview
methods.description: Provides context during layout preview, adjusting entity context.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label of the entity.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entity.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Performs access checks for layout operations based on permissions and entity state.

methods.name: handleTranslationAccess
methods.description: Refines access results considering translation status.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines if the override is applicable based on cacheability and override status.

methods.name: isOverridden
methods.description: Checks if the layout has been overridden.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if the entity type, bundle, and view mode support layout overrides.
